study type: Newborn screening program with case identification and genetic characterization
outcome: ACAT1 gene variants (c.721dupA, c.928G > C, c.238+1G > A, c.1163G > T)
cohort: A total of 203,750 newborns born in Jiangsu Province, China, were screened for Beta-ketothiolase deficiency.
finding: Two infants with Beta-ketothiolase deficiency (BKTD) were identified among 203,750 newborns, presenting with novel compound heterozygous variants in the ACAT1 gene, with one case showing metabolic acidosis and neonatal hypoglycemia 8 days after birth.
followup_time: Up to 8 days (for clinical presentation of one patient)
